principle: Use external projects as optional adapters/references; internal QA and production contracts remain authoritative.

tools.name: yt-dlp
tools.role: YouTube research metadata, search and media retrieval
tools.notes: Use for trend research only with respect for platform terms and source rights. Pin versions in CI rather than tracking master.

tools.name: PySceneDetect
tools.role: content-aware scene/cut detection and frame sampling
tools.notes: Useful for validating scene boundaries and selecting representative frames.

tools.name: pyannote-audio
tools.role: speaker diarization, speech activity and speaker-change analysis
tools.notes: Heavy dependency; keep optional for multi-speaker or dialogue stories. Model access may have separate terms.

tools.name: WhisperX
tools.role: word-level transcription/alignment for captions and clip boundaries
tools.notes: Do not vendor source until the exact upstream license and model terms are verified.

tools.name: clipforge-local
tools.notes: Evaluate architecture only until license, maintenance and reproducibility are verified.

tools.name: YT-Shorts-Automator
tools.notes: Use design ideas; do not copy code without license review.
